tooltip.mcai.model_switcher.action: Right-click: switch to the next model
tooltip.mcai.mode_switcher.action: Right-click: switch to the next mode
mcai.vision.prompt.build: Analyze the Minecraft build or redstone circuit in this screenshot: explain how it works, then suggest concrete improvements. Keep it short.
mcai.vision.prompt.describe: Describe everything important on this screen: the HUD, the blocks around me, any mobs or items, and any danger. Be concrete about positions and directions. Keep it short.
mcai.reasoning.truncated: §8... (%s of %s chars hidden; set reasoning_max_chars to 0 in mcai.json to show everything)
mcai.error.config_load: §c[AI] Failed to load the config, please check the config file.
mcai.error.no_apikey: §c[AI] apiKey is not set yet, please edit the config file first.
mcai.error.no_apiurl: §c[AI] apiUrl is not set yet, please edit the config file first.
mcai.error.unparsable: §c[AI] The API returned a response that could not be parsed.
mcai.chat.empty: §e[AI] Please type a question, for example: !ai How do I craft a diamond pickaxe?
mcai.prompt.system: You are a Minecraft game assistant. Answer the player's questions concisely in English.
mcai.persona.suffix.builder: Act as an experienced Minecraft architect. Focus on block choice, proportions and lighting; give concrete build steps.
mcai.persona.suffix.redstone: Act as a redstone engineer. Explain the circuit principle first, then give a compact, reliable design with exact block placement.
mcai.persona.suffix.survival: Act as a survival-mode guide. Prefer early-game, low-resource solutions and warn about common dangers.
mcai.persona.suffix.english: Act as an English tutor. Answer in simple English and briefly explain any difficult word you use.
mcai.vision.cooldown: §e[AI] Screenshot recognition is cooling down, wait another %ss.
mcai.vision.no_vision: §c[AI] Model %s does not support image input. Use the "AI Model Switcher" to pick a vision-capable model (for example deepseek-flash).
mcai.vision.grab_null: §c[AI] Screenshot failed: could not read the current frame.
mcai.vision.prompt: Briefly describe what you see in this Minecraft screenshot.
mcai.vision.local_hint: §e[AI] Point the endpoint at a local model (for example http://localhost:11434/v1) so no API key is required.
mcai.switch.config_not_ready: §c[AI] The config is not loaded yet, please try again in a moment.
mcai.switch.no_models: §c[AI] The model list is empty, nothing to switch to.
mcai.switch.no_modes: §c[AI] The mode list is empty, nothing to switch to.
mcai.guide.title: §b§l[mcAI] §r§fFeatures and commands
mcai.guide.config: §e /ai config §8-> §7Open the settings screen and enter your API Key
mcai.guide.model_switcher: §e Right-click "AI Model Switcher" §8-> §7Cycle through AI models
mcai.guide.mode_switcher: §e Right-click "AI Mode Switcher" §8-> §7Cycle through Chat / Vision modes
mcai.guide.vision: §e H §8-> §7Send the current screen to the AI§8 (§73s cooldown§8)
mcai.guide.build: §e G §8-> §7Analyse the build / redstone circuit you are looking at
mcai.guide.where: §e /ai where §7[question] §8-> §7Ask about your current coordinates, biome and light
mcai.guide.read: §e /ai read §8-> §7Translate the sign you look at, or the book you hold§8 (§7text only, cheap§8)
mcai.guide.craft: §e /ai craft §8-> §7What you can craft right now§8 (§7local, no tokens§8)
mcai.guide.task: §e /ai task §8-> §7Generate a task from your inventory§8 (§7show§8 / §7clear§8)
mcai.guide.chart: §e /ai chart §8-> §7Token usage chart for the last 7 days
mcai.guide.persona: §e /ai persona §7<id> §8-> §7Switch persona§8 (default / builder / redstone / survival / english)
mcai.guide.clear: §e /ai clear §8-> §7Forget the conversation context kept in memory
mcai.guide.status: §e /ai status §8-> §7Show the current model, mode, resolution and today's usage
mcai.guide.token: §e /ai token §8-> §7Show today's token usage and recent calls
mcai.guide.no_key: §c[!] API Key is not set - click here to open the settings screen

mcai.cmd.cost_unknown: §7 - No price table for §f%s§7, cost cannot be estimated.
mcai.cmd.cost_note: §8 Estimate only - cache hits and Chinese holidays are not modelled.

mcai.cmd.craft_empty: §8 Not enough materials for anything new.
mcai.cmd.craft_note: §8 Answered locally - no tokens used. Ask an item name after !ai to see its recipe.
mcai.task.prompt: Look at my inventory below and give me exactly 3 short, concrete tasks I can finish right now using only what I already have. One task per line, no numbering, no extra commentary.

mcai.cmd.token_empty: §8 No history yet. After one !ai question or an H screenshot, records are written to %s

mcai.help.title: What is an API Key?
mcai.help.body1: It is the "passport" for calling an AI service. This mod sends the key
mcai.help.body2: to the provider's servers, which use it to identify and bill your account.
